edition: PostgreSQL 13+ over the libpq wire protocol via psycopg 3.3.6; verified locally against PostgreSQL 16.15

user.description: A read-only role (NOSUPERUSER, no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on allowlisted schemas)

user_context_setting.description: GUC the customer's RLS policies read, e.g. app.current_user

operations.name: check_connection
operations.description: Connect, verify server version >= 13, verify the role is read-only on the allowlisted schemas

operations.name: discover
operations.description: List tables/views the role can SELECT in allowlisted schemas with column types and RLS flag

operations.name: query
operations.description: Run one guarded SELECT in a READ ONLY transaction with statement_timeout, server-side parameters and a row cap

limitations: Live read queries only; no record sync / CDC (that is a separate future surface)
The static SQL guard is conservative: identifiers that collide with forbidden keywords are rejected even inside valid SELECTs; use quoted identifiers
Per-user policy depends on the customer defining RLS policies that read the configured GUC; without it, all queries run as the connection role
Cloud IAM/OAuth token authentication (RDS IAM, Azure AD) is not implemented; password auth only
search_path is forced to pg_catalog: queries must schema-qualify relations
